name: Sir Seewoosagur Ramgoolam International Airport

runway.v: one runway, 14/32, 3,040 m long and 45 m wide (runway 14 threshold displaced 330 m)

customs.v: customs and immigration as operationally required ("HO"), not stated as 24 hours

hours.v: air traffic services 24 hours (H24); the airport operator's office is open Monday to Friday 04:45-12:00 UTC (08:45-16:00 local) and closed weekends and holidays

fuel.v: Jet A1, 24 hours, with at least 12 hours' notice outside 02:00-19:00 UTC (06:00-23:00 local)
fuel.quote: Service available 24 HR with at least 12 HR PN if operating outside 0200 - 1900 UTC

handling.v: handling available 24 hours; hangar space for general aviation at YU Lounge, and at Air Mauritius
handling.quote: Hangar space is available at Air Mauritius & at YU Lounge for General Aviation

max_aircraft.v: general aviation apron is bays 41-48; code C or larger aircraft should not be parked on bays 46, 47 and 48; Code F aircraft (e.g. A380) use the main apron
max_aircraft.quote: Avoid parking of code C (or higher) aircraft on BAY 46, 47 and 48 on the General Aviation Apron

noise.v: no noise abatement procedures published (AD 2.21 nil)

notes: The AIP page shows no effective date or amendment number; it sits in the eAIP set labelled 'eAIPMauritius_12_11_2024_updated'. Newer editions exist (eAIP 16 Dec 2024 PDF; Non-AIRAC AMDT 1/25 effective 15 May 2025) but could not be opened, so a later amendment may change these values. Customs 'HO' means available to meet operational requirements, not a fixed timetable. Local time is UTC+4 (no DST). No night restriction is stated in AD 2 FIMP; curfew left missing rather than 'none'.
